data.long_meaning: The name Nolie is believed to derive from the Old French word 'nouvellie', meaning 'new' or 'fresh'. In a spiritual context, it can be interpreted as a name of comfort and freedom, symbolizing a new beginning or a fresh start. The name Nolie carries the meaning “Freedom, Comfort” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nolie usually hope their child will grow to embody freedom, comfort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
